_comment: This file is the single source of truth for deployed protocol addresses.
Descriptions and source fields explain how each address should be used.
Only entries with proxy metadata are inspected by the proxy-history updater.
Implementation histories are informative; integrations must call stable proxy addresses.
The TypeScript exports derive their metadata and address-only lookups from this file.

governor.description: Governance executor authorized to run approved protocol changes.

oracleManager.description: Oracle manager coordinating coin pairs, oracle selection, and staking.

mocRegistry.description: Governed registry of legacy MoC and shared flow contracts.

mocToken.description: Canonical MOC governance and fee token.

docToken.description: Canonical DOC stable token shared by the legacy MoC and RoC integrations.

mocStateV1.description: Legacy MoC v1 state and pricing contract.

supporters.description: Oracle Supporters proxy that accounts for stake and distributes oracle rewards.

foundation.description: Protocol foundation or treasury recipient used by fee-distribution contracts.

tasksRunner.description: Stable TasksRunner proxy used by selected oracles to execute scheduled protocol maintenance.

docToRbtcPriceProvider.description: Price provider quoting DOC in RBTC. Use when a consumer explicitly requires a DOC/RBTC price.

rbtcToMocMocRewardsReverseAuction.description: Reverse auction converting RBTC into MOC for the MOC rewards buffer.

mocV1.description: Stable proxy for the legacy Money on Chain v1 core protocol.

mocInrateV1.description: Legacy MoC v1 interest-rate and commission contract.

coiner.description: Stable Coiner proxy used by the shared reward-minting flow. Use the proxy address, never an implementation address.

multicall2.description: Shared Multicall2 deployment used to batch read-only calls. It is infrastructure, not a protocol-owned proxy.

vendor.description: Vendor account supplied by the MoC application so operations can be attributed for vendor commissions.

rns.description: Canonical Rootstock Name Service registry for this network.

rifBucket.description: Stable proxy for the RIF-backed RoC collateral bucket whose pegged token is USD-rif.

mocToRifBasePriceProvider.description: Base provider used to derive a MOC/RIF price. Prefer the final directional provider when one is available.
